ap_computer_science_a-f01.title: ParkingFee: charged hours and a tiered fee with a maximum

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Write the method hoursCharged, which returns the number of hours charged for a stay of the given number of minutes. Any fraction of an hour counts as a full hour. For example, hoursCharged(61) returns 2, hoursCharged(120) returns 2, and hoursCharged(0) returns 0. Complete the method hoursCharged.

rubric_rows.criterion: Converts minutes to whole hours by dividing by 60 with integer division; Rounds the hours up when there are leftover minutes.
common_errors: uses double division without a cast

rubric_rows.criterion: Leaves exact multiples of 60, and 0 minutes, without an extra hour
common_errors: adds an hour for exact multiples

rubric_rows.criterion: Returns the resulting int hour count

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Write the method totalFee, which returns the total fee, in dollars, for a stay of the given number of minutes. The first two charged hours cost 4 dollars each, every additional charged hour costs 3 dollars, and the total never exceeds 20 dollars. You must use hoursCharged appropriately to receive full credit. For example, totalFee(125) returns 11, because 3 hours are charged: 4 + 4 + 3. Complete the method totalFee.

rubric_rows.criterion: Obtains the charged hours by calling hoursCharged; Charges 4 dollars for each of the first two charged hours.
required_elements: 4 dollars for each of the first two hours
common_errors: uses 3 dollars for the first two hours

rubric_rows.criterion: Charges 3 dollars for each charged hour after the second
Applies the 20-dollar maximum so that the result never exceeds 20
Returns the fee as an int in every case, including 0 minutes
common_errors: leaves the fee uninitialized on a path
